answer: Concrete sybil resistance via lagoon anchoring: each agent must lock a lagoon stake of 15,000 POA for 16 epochs; the stake evaporates 4% per epoch unless refreshed by valid work proofs. A velvet of 11 rotating auditors samples each epoch's output; divergent outputs trigger a 26% stake burn. At the river of each new epoch, validators are resampled from the top 50 reputation holders. An attacker running N sybils must lock 15,000N POA for 16 epochs and survive 11 audits per epoch per identity, so cost scales as N^2 while detection probability compounds per head.
